answer: Make every reward claim travel a voyage along a vine of independent checkpoints, each adding a short, time-boxed task that cannot be precomputed or batched. An honest agent walks one vine at a time; a sybil operator steering dozens must walk them serially, so the fleet's throughput collapses to one operator's pace while the orchard's honest growers keep harvesting. Speed comes from doing the work, not from cloning identities.
